archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY & DIGNIFIED BACK-OFFICE (Warm Sand, Deep Slate, Jade Green, Amber Gold)
emotional_tone: Warm, trustworthy, serene, highly efficient, professional Indonesian Buddhist Foundation back-office with gold/amber/jade accents, crisp data density, and flawless CJK Chinese typography.

typography.font_family_heading: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
typography.font_family_body: 'Plus Jakarta Sans Variable', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans CJK SC', sans-serif
typography.cjk_rendering_note: Ensures Hanzi (simplified & traditional like 廣吉, 施主, 功德主, 許文強) renders seamlessly inline alongside Indonesian donor names with balanced height and crisp weight.

entry_surfaces./login: split branded login — warm sand Buddhist foundation intro panel with lotus/wheel motif & positioning left, secure credential + role switcher form right
entry_surfaces./: finance command center — top KPI cards, BCA mutasi daily reconciliation alert bar, urgent verification table, program target progress bento

layouts.app_shell: Two-column responsive layout with dark slate left sidebar (collapsible on mobile into Sheet drawer), top sticky crystal glass bar with quick BCA import CTA, donor search shortcut (Cmd+K), notification center, and user avatar/role pill.
layouts.bento_grid: Dense back-office grid (gap-4 md:gap-6). KPI summary cards top (4 cols), middle split 8 cols (Mutasi / Verification Queue) + 4 cols (Program target progress & reconciliation status), bottom audit feed and quick export shortcuts.
layouts.tables: Dense financial table: sticky header, zebra row-hover, monospace IDR currency, bilingual donor badges (e.g., 'Budi Santoso (許文強)'), inline dropdowns for verification status & program tags, batch selection checkboxes with bulk action floating toolbar.

visual_enhancers.gold_trim: Delicate warm amber/gold border highlight on active cards and total dana accumulators (`border-amber-500/30 shadow-amber-500/5`)
visual_enhancers.currency_formatting: Always formatted in Indonesian standard Rupiah `Rp 1.250.000` with mono font for digit alignment in tables
visual_enhancers.split_indicator: Visual progress bar showing remaining split amount vs total mutasi transfer in Split Modal (`Sisa Belum Dialokasikan: Rp 0`) with instant validation warning if sum != total
visual_enhancers.reconciliation_card: Color-coded bank balance vs categorized balance status chip ('Klop / Seimbang' in green or 'Selisih Rp X' in red).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the complete operational finance suite for 'Yayasan Dana Paramita Guang Ji Indonesia' (印尼廣吉慈善功德基金會).
Support full bilingual donor records: Nama Latin (e.g. 'Handoko Wijaya') and Nama Mandarin (e.g. '黃德興' or '王小明') with Pinyin search capability.
Implement BCA CSV / Excel statement uploader with preview parser, auto-deduplication by unique bank ref / timestamp, and configurable column mapping in Settings.

Provide rich seed data with realistic Indonesian Buddhist dana categories: Dana Operasional Vihara, Cetak Kitab Suci, Fang Sheng (Pelepasan Satwa), Paket Sembako Waisak, Pengobatan Lansia, Pembangunan Graha Samadhi, Dana Pelita / Lilin.
Status flags for verification workflow: 'Belum Cek' (amber), 'Sudah OK' (green), 'Perlu Cek' (red) with instant one-click toggle or inline select in table.
Split transaction feature: Allows single incoming bank credit (e.g. Rp 5.000.000) to be divided into multiple donor contributions / programs with live remaining amount indicator.
Export feature: Export verified mutasi or donor list to Excel (.xlsx) / CSV and printable official Kwitansi / Bukti Tanda Terima Dana.
Role switcher / Auth: Ketua/Bendahara (Full access), Staf Admin (Input & categorize), Rekan Pengecek (Quick PIN-based verification), Auditor (Read-only + audit log view).
Dark mode toggle using next-themes / class='dark' with smooth slate/obsidian palette.
Ensure every button, input, select, table row, and modal has explicit data-testid attributes for testing.
